briefHtml:
NAV S$10,081,431 - reported -1.12%, recorded -0.06% d/d (-0.56% vs Wednesday; first print below S$10.1m)

  • Biggest mover: silver - new 52-week low $40.86 Friday, -3.9% Friday, -9.3% over the two missed sessions; leveraged IBKR line down to ~1.67x, equity approx S$37,400 (-20% in two sessions)
  • The one thing: Friday was a broad liquidation - Dow's worst week since COVID (-8%), SPX and Dow both in correction, Nasdaq negative for 2026, VIX 35.89 (highest since Apr 2025). AI unwind (NVDA -14% Friday, -23% week) and metals unwind (silver -9.3%, gold -8.6% week) hit together; Treasuries the only bid (10y 4.92%). Shenzhen trilateral: four-point peace declaration, zero trade/chip/rare-earth content. No briefs Fri-Sun; this covers Thu+Fri.

Markets (Thu + Fri)

  • US Fri: SPX 6,910.39 -3.70% (-10.7% from Oct record = correction); Dow 48,147.33 -1.93% (correction); Nasdaq 22,617.73 -5.28% (negative YTD); NVDA $125.53 -14% (week -23%); VIX 35.89 +26%; 10y 4.92% -13bp; BTC under $59k
  • US Thu: SPX 7,175.83 -2.02%; ANT debut - opened $111.50 (+34%), closed $97.17 (+17.1%), approx $1.28tn
  • Asia Fri: HSI 22,410.80 -3.8% (bear market, -20% from Jan peak; HS Tech 8th straight loss); STI 4,975.17 -2.05% (below 5,000); Tencent HK$344.00 -1.3% (Thu -6.55% on Q3 miss); DBS S$66.11 -1.8%; Nikkei -5.06%
  • Metals: gold futures approx $3,553-3,573 (-8.55% week; spot low $3,513.54 = 14-month low); silver $40.86 (Thu $42.54); SLVP $24.12 -4.9% (NAV $24.05 = 52-week low, -36% on the quarter)
  • FX: USDSGD 1.2898; USDCNY approx 6.66; DXY approx 103.8 near 19-month high

Flags

  • 8 critical flags - all are 5-session windows mislabeled "in a day" (Tencent -11.0% and silver -11.0% match 11-13 closes exactly; miner flags plausible over 5 sessions: SLVP -18.3%)
  • Listed book -6.65% "today" is the same artefact; recorded NAV -0.06% d/d is the truth
  • L46.SI Yahoo 404 - 38th session

Insider trades

  • None found (SGX API 404 for the 9th straight trading day; Wing Tai pause 11 sessions; no HKEX disclosures for Tencent/SMIC/Xiaomi; US holdings are ETFs)

Congress trades

  • No new filings dated 11/18-11/20; most recent remain 11/16-11/17: FL-19 (buys IBKR; sells NFLX, ZTS, ADSK), CA-50 ($500k-1M T-Bill sale), IL-1 (DDOG, EL buys; BP, SPHR sells), AR-2 (JBGS sale), WA-1 muni switches
  • Source: Unusual Whales

Trump / policy

  • Shenzhen trilateral: four-point declaration (UN reform, refined petroleum, ICC immunity, nuclear-risk dialogue); no Ukraine, Iran, trade, chips or rare earths; Busan-truce extension not announced AP
  • Rare earths deadlines: US Pentagon ban on China/NK/Iran/Russia-sourced magnets, tantalum, tungsten from Jan 1 2027 (EO 14415); China's export-control pause expires Jan 10 MINING.COM
  • Fed: Cook - hike now or fall behind; Waller doubles down on jumbo December hike; Dec 25bp approx 92-97.5% priced, 8% hold re-appeared Yahoo Finance
  • AI politics hostile: "Blue Tidal Wave" anti-datacenter DC fears top Ives' selloff list; SAFE AI Act outline; House released NVDA/AMD China license data; Trump opposes "globalist AI regulation" Yahoo Finance
  • ANT $88.91 Friday (-8.5%) but above $83 IPO; day-one Buys: Needham $150, Wolfe $135, Citizens $125
  • Trump-Philippines "very big trade deal" (energy, food security); fresh US SEA semiconductor export restrictions weigh on Singapore tech Manila Times

Risk

  • Silver line ~1.67x, equity approx S$37,400 (-20% in two sessions); -$1 silver = -S$2,292 equity; ~$33 = maintenance-margin stress zone
  • Tape: SPX/Dow corrections, Nasdaq-100 approx -19% (bear-market edge), VIX 35.89, HSI bear market, STI below 5,000
  • DBS -5.4% on the week (2% of NW); FX ~35% non-SGD with DXY near 19-month high; Asia opens Monday into a VIX-35 US close
  • Rates paradox: 10y 4.92% on the risk-off bid while a Dec hike stays approx 92% priced

Alpha (signals, not advice)

  • Real assets: gold $3,700-3,730 trigger demolished (spot low $3,513); unlevered sleeve waits for gold to hold approx $3,500 for 2-3 sessions; silver line gets nothing
  • AI bottlenecks: NVDA $150-155 floor destroyed ($125.53); ANT holding above $83 says private demand is real; first staged tranche only after a 2-3 session base, not into a VIX-36 tape
  • Defense: 10y 4.92% - the 5.20% gate is 28bp away and receding; deploy TLT in size AT the gate only, even if it does not arrive before Dec 9

trumpWatch.title: Shenzhen trilateral: four-point peace declaration, zero trade content
trumpWatch.detail: First Trump-Xi-Putin sit-down (Thu) produced a Heads of State Declaration toward Peace: UN reform, higher refined-petroleum supply, state-official immunity vs the ICC, nuclear-risk dialogue. No mention of Ukraine, Iran, trade, tariffs, chips or rare earths; the Busan-truce extension past Jan 10 was not announced. Trump praised Xi, called Putin 'my friend'.

trumpWatch.title: Rare-earth deadlines calendared: Jan 1 US, Jan 10 China
trumpWatch.detail: EO 14415 enforcement: from Jan 1 2027 Pentagon contractors may not buy magnets, tantalum or tungsten mined, refined or separated in China, North Korea, Iran or Russia (gallium/germanium follow Dec 2027). China's rare-earth export-control pause expires Jan 10 2027, nine days later - a supply-squeeze window for defence suppliers.

trumpWatch.title: Fed hawks press into the crash
trumpWatch.detail: Cook (Fri): hike now or risk falling behind the curve. Waller doubled down on a jumbo December hike and more hikes to come. Dec 9 FOMC: 25bp approx 92-97.5% priced; an 8% hold chance re-appeared Friday as stocks crashed.

trumpWatch.title: AI politics turns hostile in DC
trumpWatch.detail: Ives' selloff catalyst list is topped by the 'Blue Tidal Wave' midterm win and anti-AI/anti-datacenter DC fears; SAFE AI Act outline (Jacobs/Maloy/Beyer) would impose federal safety rules on frontier labs; House released data showing 879k of 3.4m requested NVDA/AMD China chips approved - re-energising China hawks post-Huang. Trump at APEC opposed 'globalist AI regulation'.

trumpWatch.title: Friday: worst week since COVID/Liberation Day
trumpWatch.detail: SPX -8.6% on the week (worst since Apr 2025), Dow -8% (worst since Mar 2020), Nasdaq -10% (worst since Mar 2020); SPX and Dow closed in correction; Nasdaq negative for 2026; NVDA -23% on the week (worst since Oct 2008); VIX 35.89, highest close since Apr 11 2025; 10y rallied to 4.92%.

trumpWatch.title: ANT holds above IPO price through the crash
trumpWatch.detail: Anthropic opened $111.50 (+34%) Thursday, closed day one $97.17 (+17.1%), then -8.5% Friday to $88.91 - still above the $83 IPO price. Largest IPO ever ($107.3bn incl. $26bn placement). Day-one Buys: Needham $150, Wolfe $135, Citizens $125.

trumpWatch.title: Trump-Philippines trade deal; SEA chip curbs bite Singapore
trumpWatch.detail: Trump announced a 'very big trade deal' with the Philippines (energy, food security) Wednesday. Fresh US export restrictions on advanced semiconductors and computing services into Southeast Asia are weighing on Singapore data-centre and semis names; Singapore October NODX +79.8% y/y.
